messages.subject: geom_hex() + coord_map(project) issue
parts:
I'm not sure if this issue is known. If it is how do I get around it?
geom_hex only works with coord_map(project="cylindrical") which I
think is the default. For any other value of the projection the hex
bins do not appear.

---
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
WY <- qplot(x,y,data=as.data.frame(map("county", "wyoming", plot =
FALSE)[c("x", "y")]), geom='path')

data<-data.frame(
rx=rnorm(1000, -108.05, sd=1), #- Longitude 104°3'W to 111°3'W
ry=rnorm(1000,43, sd=.5)# - Latitude 41°N to 45°N
)

# works
WY+geom_point(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry))+coord_map(project="azequalarea")
WY+geom_hex(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry)) + coord_map(project="cylindrical")

# does not work
# hex bins do not appear.
WY+geom_hex(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry)) + coord_map(project="azequalarea")
WY+geom_hex(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry)) + coord_map(project="gilbert")
WY+geom_hex(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry)) + coord_map(project="lagrange")
WY+geom_hex(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry)) + coord_map(project="orthographic")
WY+geom_hex(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry)) + coord_map(project="conic", lat0=41)
WY+geom_hex(data=data, mapping=aes(rx,ry)) + coord_map(project="bonne", lat0=41)
---

Thanks,
Andrew
